section: Accidental Deaths and Suicides in India 1970
title: 20 TABLE IX— The highest number of suicidal deaths was recorded in the State of West Bengal (6938), followed by Uttar Pradesh (6338), Maharashtra (5730), Tamil Nadu (5199) and Andhra Pradesh (4258) and the highest volume of suicidal deaths per one lakh of population was also noticed in West Bengal (15.4), followed by Kerala (14.8), Tamil Nadu (13.1), Maharashtra (11.4) and Orissa (11.6), as against an average of (8.8) for all the States together. The 7 Union Territories contributed only 1.2% to the total suicidal deaths in the country. The volume of suicide per one lakh of population in the Cities under study is slightly less than the All-India average viz. 6.4%. However, Bangalore (12.9), Hyderabad (19.2) and Madras (17.3) recorded a much higher volume of suicides than the average of all the Cities together. The relevant statistics are furnished in Table X.
